scope: Synchronize durable original-command evidence from edge execution receipts into cloud detail, including late original results after cancellation

behavior.wire_contract: Execution root JSON fields are retained. Optional receipt_source has schema_version=1, authenticated node_id, source execution version and recorded_ms. command_evidence carries all immutable evidence for that execution on each newly committed receipt.
behavior.validation: Sender remains admitted by mTLS and current edge ownership. Receipt source node/version must match authenticated delivery and execution identity. Evidence must bind original published definition version, execution, command, step, device, bound payload hash, collection time and trusted source/result provenance. Referenced trusted evidence must match the step result.
behavior.atomicity: Evidence, execution local version, transition, durable outbox/receipt and signed audit commit or roll back together. Cloud receipt audit preserves original evidence and authenticated source node/version/time; original evidence TraceID is retained.
behavior.replay_ordering: Same delivery identity with altered content conflicts. Same evidence ID with altered content conflicts across deliveries and source versions. Older source versions and fences may add immutable feedback without regressing state or source cursor. Legacy plain Execution receipts remain accepted. Confirmed evidence identities cannot be erased or replaced by receipt/checkpoint progression.
behavior.late_cancel_result: Late confirmed original command responses are captured once as trusted control.action_journal:<node> evidence with request/result hashes, platform journal time, original command identity and available TraceID; cancellation still prevents remaining commands.
behavior.read_authorization: Current principal, original published resources, current resource ancestry and every evidence device remain required for execution detail and operation results. Cloud HTTP evidence and feedback timeline use existing public types.
behavior.public_api: No public HTTP field or generated client schema changed; all 99 pre-C05 contract files remain byte-for-byte identical.
